teleporter/31699.htm.text: Gatekeeper Stanislava: Since the Rune Township is so big, Alicia and I were picked to help in a crisis. I have to stay inside, but she is out in the weather in front of the temple! I see I'm boring you. Shall I guide you to the temple?

teleporter/31699-pk.htm.text: Gatekeeper Stanislava: You don't have permission to use the gate of time and space! Get lost or I'll call the guards!
